content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so retro authorization, records, appeal with necessity, and peer-to-peer would not properly address it. No specific coding or modifier correction is established, and resubmitting as-is risks an improper duplicate; the contractual denial also should not be billed to the patient. A billing specialist must review the related paid service and payer bundling policy to determine whether a valid coding correction or reconsideration is available."}
